summary: Junie by JetBrains is a coding agent installed from the terminal. Its homepage announces Junie Lite as a free AI layer with no trial and no card, described in the pricing section as a free model that is always on in every JetBrains account. The Free to Start plan is listed as Free, with other AI usage billed separately; bring-your-own-key usage is billed at provider rates with zero markup.
claim_steps: Open a terminal and run the install command from junie.jetbrains.com: curl -fsSL https://junie.jetbrains.com/install.sh | bash
Sign in with your JetBrains Account to use the free Junie Lite model

social_proof.title: Junie by JetBrains
social_proof.text: New: Junie Lite – free AI layer, no trial, no card. ... A free model, always on, in every JetBrains account.
